title: County electoral divisions, May 2023 (England, generalised, clipped)
description: The electoral divisions county councils are elected by, the county tier equivalent of a ward.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "County_Electoral_Division_May_2023_Boundaries_EN_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/County_Electoral_Division_May_2023_Boundaries_EN_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 1,367 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
